characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored a 4.5-hour Lethal Company co-op session with rotating crew, navigating moons Experimentation, Offense, and Titan while managing inventory, quotas, and frequent deaths.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Joined the Lethal Company crew as a regular player, frequently dying to brackens, coil heads, and goo, and at one point glitching into a duplicated state across the facility.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell hosted an extended Lethal Company marathon (4h31m) with a large rotating lobby, reaching moons Experimentation, Offense, and Titan while accumulating and losing significant scrap quotas.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News anchor Case Blackwell suspended regular programming for a marathon Lethal Company co-op session, leading a shifting crew through multiple quota runs on Experimentation, Offense, and Titan. The crew secured high-value hauls — including hair dryers, painting, and apparatus — but suffered repeated wipes to brackens, coil heads, nutcrackers, and eclipse dogs. Despite heavy losses, the team cleared quota repeatedly, ending the night with a jetpack-assisted escape and a promise to return tomorrow.
